about.title: About This Game Wiki Template
about.metaDescription: Learn how this reusable non-Roblox game wiki template handles verified sources, game replacement, localization, and independent editorial content.
about.intro: This repository is a reusable foundation for an independent game guide site and does not currently represent a selected game.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: A new project starts with a game name and domain, then replaces every placeholder with researched information before publication.

sections.title: Editorial approach
sections.body: Entries distinguish verified facts from unanswered questions and do not use invented walkthroughs or unsupported claims.

sections.title: Independence
sections.body: Sites created from this template are independent fan resources unless an authorized owner explicitly states otherwise.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Review the starter privacy, analytics, advertising, and cookie guidance included with this reusable independent game wiki template.
privacy.intro: This starter policy must be reviewed against the services enabled on the deployed game site.

sections.title: Information we process
sections.body: A deployed site may receive basic server logs and aggregated technical information needed for security and reliability.

sections.title: Advertising and cookies
sections.body: Optional analytics and advertising storage should remain disabled until consent is provided and the deployed services are documented.

sections.title: Contact and changes
sections.body: Publish an owner-controlled contact method and update this policy whenever the site's data practices change.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaTitle: Terms of Service — Game Wiki Template
terms.metaDescription: Review the starter terms governing use of an independent fan guide created from this reusable non-Roblox game wiki template.
terms.intro: These starter terms must be updated for the selected game, domain, and services before publication.

sections.title: Informational purpose
sections.body: Game information can change, and visitors should verify purchases, account actions, requirements, and live values through official channels.

sections.title: No affiliation
sections.body: A site created from this template is not affiliated with or endorsed by a developer, publisher, or platform holder unless explicitly stated.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Visitors must not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, or republish substantial portions as their own site.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.metaDescription: Review the starter ownership, fan-site media use, attribution, and rights-holder guidance for this reusable game wiki template.
copyright.intro: Replace this starter copy with the selected game's ownership and attribution details before publishing.

sections.title: Fan-site use
sections.body: Only publish game media that can lawfully support identification, commentary, reporting, or guide context.

sections.title: Site content
sections.body: Original editorial text and site code remain subject to their applicable licenses and may not be republished in bulk without permission.

sections.title: Rights concerns
sections.body: Publish a rights-holder contact channel for attribution changes, corrections, or removal requests.

notFound.title: Page not found
